title: Joining a Park Cleanup
title_zh: 参加社区公园清洁活动
context: Emma 准备参加周日的社区公园清洁活动，邀请朋友 Noah 一起参加。

dialogue.speaker: Emma
dialogue.en: Hey, Noah, are you doing anything on Sunday morning?
dialogue.zh: 嘿，诺亚，你周日早上有安排吗？

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: Not much. Why do you ask?

dialogue.speaker: Emma
dialogue.en: I'm joining a neighborhood park cleanup. Want to come along?
dialogue.zh: 我要参加社区公园清洁活动。想一起去吗？

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: Maybe! I've never done anything like that before. What would we actually do?
dialogue.zh: 也许可以！我以前从没参加过类似活动。具体要做些什么？

dialogue.speaker: Emma
dialogue.en: We'd pick up litter and help plant a few small trees.
dialogue.zh: 我们会捡垃圾，还会帮忙种几棵小树。

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: That sounds useful. Do we need to bring our own supplies?
dialogue.zh: 听起来挺有意义。我们需要自带工具吗？

dialogue.speaker: Emma
dialogue.en: No, the organizers provide gloves and trash bags. Just wear shoes you don't mind getting dirty.
dialogue.zh: 不用，组织方会提供手套和垃圾袋。穿一双不怕弄脏的鞋就好。

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: Good to know. How early does it start?

dialogue.speaker: Emma
dialogue.en: At nine. It usually takes about two hours.
dialogue.zh: 九点。一般大概持续两个小时。

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: I usually sleep in on Sundays, but this sounds worth getting up for.
dialogue.zh: 我周日通常会睡懒觉，但这次活动值得我早起。

dialogue.speaker: Emma
dialogue.en: We could grab breakfast afterward. That might make it easier!
dialogue.zh: 我们可以活动后一起吃早餐。这样早起也许就没那么难啦！

expressions.example: We're going hiking tomorrow. Want to come along?

pronunciation: 练习 want to 的弱读，以及 COUNT me IN 的重音。

practice.title: IELTS Speaking Part 1 · Parks
practice.prompt: Do you enjoy spending time in parks?
practice.answer: 说明习惯、原因和个人经历。

practice.title: IELTS Speaking Part 2
practice.prompt: Describe a community activity you would like to take part in.
practice.answer: 活动介绍 → 具体计划 → 参加原因 → 预期感受。

practice.title: 听力理解
practice.prompt: Why was Noah unsure about joining the activity at first?
practice.answer: 他没有参加过类似活动，而且习惯在周日睡懒觉。
